title: Lebara $250 Pre-Paid SIM Starter Kit + 2000 Everyday Rewards Points $159 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: Lebara $250 Pre-Paid SIM Starter Kit + 2000 Everyday Rewards Points $159 @ Woolworths

[yht] Will 10% off be applied when purchasing this though ?
[Skilly] No vodafone network for me ever! I can barely make calls only on their network let alone the data
[MasterScythe] Heavily location dependant, ol' Vody.
A lot of folks haven't re-tried in 2026 yet either since the optus share.
Switched my parents, theyre doing the semi-local nomad thing.
In metro Brisbane, as far north to maryborough and as far south as tweed, it smashes both telstra and optus coverage, tested on 3 very different handsets (samsung with bluetick certification, iphone 16, cheap motorola).
Slightly inland can get more patchy, but my father is a distance rider and once you get far enough in that nobody (used to) have coverage, dirt road towns, the voda 'black spot program' they dumped bulk money into a decade ago has typically added a local tower.
Also, a lot changed about a year ago when they signed to tower share with Optus.
Big positive other than price; ive never measured lower latency data.
Top speed is lower, typically maxes out at 100mbps, but the response is only juuuust breaking away from single digits (which is rare for a mobile network).
[BargainBoo] Not as good as Boost, but ok for the price. I'm in Sydney's metro so coverage is decent but I notice indoors can be a bit spotty at times. They also gave me 5gb bonus data shortly after joining.
[Notatightass] Is Boost any good these days in Sydney? I used it a few yrs ago, but absolutely could not get data working even with a full bar in places like Westfields.
[knowwhat] If one has Woolworths insurance, does it provide the 10% discount?
[bashar20] Yep. Purchase with your groceries for the month.
[3sky] Yep the 10% insurance discount applied no problem
[findcaiyzh] Can I buy 2 to get 4000 points?
and what is the acitvated by?
Need 2 or 3 for my parent and ln laws.
[welcomeUniverseWorld] Unfortunately, you would not be able to use the Lebara eSIM for cellular data on your smart watch. We are working on enabling eSIM for smart watches and it will be available soon.
